title: Tuck in the king
summary: Castle early so the king is safe and the rook joins in.

steps.md: Kings like to be **tucked in**. Castle early, then your rook can join the game too.

steps.prompt: Castle to keep your king safe!
steps.hint: Move your king two squares to the right.
Move the black king two squares toward the rook on h8.

steps.question: Why do we castle?
choices: To keep the king safe and free the rook

steps.md: Centre, pieces out, king safe: the three opening rules!
